name: Snackbar
description: A brief auto-dismissing notification bar anchored to the bottom of the screen. Supports an optional action button. Uses a SnackbarProvider and useSnackbar hook pattern for imperative creation.

accessibility.role: status (polite) or alert (assertive for error variant)
notes: The snackbar uses aria-live='assertive' for error variant and aria-live='polite' for all others.
aria-atomic='true' ensures screen readers announce the full snackbar message.
Snackbars are rendered in a Portal attached to document.body.

actionLabel.description: Text for an optional action button.

onAction.description: Callback fired when the action button is clicked.

subcomponents.SnackbarProvider: Wraps the application. Required to use useSnackbar.
subcomponents.useSnackbar: Hook that returns { snackbar(options) } for imperative creation.

do: Use SnackbarProvider once at the root of your app.
Use the useSnackbar hook to trigger snackbars from anywhere in the tree.
Keep snackbar messages brief — a single sentence or fragment.
Use action buttons for undo or retry patterns.
dont: Do not use Snackbar for persistent messages — use Alert or Notification.
Do not stack more than one snackbar at a time.
Do not place interactive elements beyond the single action button.
